newsitem.title: USA: EMERY WORLDWIDE REPORTS INCREASED VOLUMES.
newsitem.headline: EMERY WORLDWIDE REPORTS INCREASED VOLUMES.

text.p: Emery Worldwide Wednesday reported significant increases in systemwide volumes and shipment counts as a result of the United Parcel Service (UPS) work stoppage.
Emery President and Chief Executive Officer David Beatson said Emery experienced a 40 percent increase in systemwide weight on August 5 and 6, with a tripling of total shipment numbers.
He said Emery's Next-Day shipment counts nearly doubled, 2nd Day shipment counts quadrupled and deferred shipment counts increased ninefold. Average shipment weight decreased by 40 percent.

"We responded to this surge by adding nine primetime flights to the 61 flights that had been scheduled," he said. "This increased our primetime aircraft capacity by 500,000 pounds, or 15 percent overall."

He said shippers who do not hold accounts with Emery are being accommodated where possible on a space available basis. "However, we continue to only accept shipments that fit Emery's market niche, namely business-to-business shipments of five pounds and above."
Emery Worldwide is a subsidiary of CNF Transportation.
